Refactored the insert path in [open_addressing_linear_probing.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/015_open_addressing_linear_probing/open_addressing_linear_probing.java) so overwriting an existing key no longer triggers preemptive resize/rehash work. `putResult` now probes first, and only goes through the new `prepareInsertionSlot(...)` path when the key is actually absent.
